summary:
MacBook screen cracked, battery swollen, keyboard playing up or a laptop that won't power on? If you're in Centurion, you don't need to sit in N1 traffic to get it fixed.

Our workshop at Silvercrest Shopping Centre in Silvamonte is about 35 km away, roughly 42 minutes' drive. For a flat R300, we collect your MacBook from your door and return it once it's repaired, insured both ways.

We repair MacBooks at component level in our static-safe lab. Every job starts with a free diagnostic, so you get a clear price first, and repairs carry a 6-month warranty.

Tap Learn more for Centurion collection details.
